acceptanceCriteria: Route /kudos loads publicly without redirect and renders h1 'He thong ghi nhan va cam on'
HIGHLIGHT KUDOS, SPOTLIGHT BOARD and ALL KUDOS sections all render with the eyebrow 'Sun* Annual Awards 2025'
Hashtag filter menu offers exactly 13 options and department filter menu exactly 48, verbatim from the dropdown frames
Selecting a filter re-filters both the highlight carousel and the all-kudos feed, AND-combines, and resets the carousel to slide 1
Highlight carousel shows at most 5 slides ordered by heart count descending, with arrows disabled at each end and pagination text current/total
Kudos card renders sender, receiver, badge with its hoa-thi tooltip, timestamp, campaign label, hashtags, heart and Copy Link
Heart is disabled for an anon viewer and for the sender's own kudos; for a signed-in viewer it toggles aria-pressed and moves the count by exactly 1
Heart state persists across a page reload, proving the Supabase data layer is real rather than client state
Copy Link writes the kudos URL to the clipboard and shows the toast 'Link copied - ready to share!'
Spotlight board renders 388 KUDOS, the seven seeded recipient names, the ticker, and its search narrows the nodes
Sidebar renders the five stat rows in the exact recorded order plus the Mo Secret Box button and the gift leaderboard
Every screen string ships in both vi and en, compile-time enforced by the Dictionary interface
All new schema is reachable only per RLS: select for anon and authenticated, insert and delete on kudos_likes restricted to auth.uid()
npm run typecheck, npm run lint and the kudos Playwright suite all exit 0
Every new code file stays under the repo's 200-line cap

blastRadius: lib/i18n/messages/dictionary.ts is shared by every screen: a malformed kudos namespace breaks typecheck for login, homepage and award-system alike
playwright.config.ts is shared by the whole E2E suite: a bad project entry can silently stop other specs from matching
supabase/seed.sql runs on db reset and the e2e auth setup creates real auth users, so a seed that collides with auth.users or that reset wipes can break the existing authenticated specs
app/kudos/page.tsx is the destination of the homepage nav and the KudosPromo CTA, both already shipped and asserted by homepage specs
getPageContext and HomeHeader are shared chrome: changing them to serve this screen would affect every route
The first RLS policies in the repo set the precedent every later table follows
